children: Nike is looking to offer a smaller array of shoe styles, but with more new models. The company is cutting in half the total number of footwear models in its sportswear business, Nike Brand President Amy Montagne says during an investor day call. About half of Nike's sportswear revenue comes from a small number of styles, which Nike hopes to change by diversifying its portfolio, she says. Less than 10% of sportswear revenue comes from new models or updates to existing models. The goal is for that percentage to increase to 40% by fiscal year 2031, Montagne says.(katherine.hamilton@wsj.com)
